thread:
noah: hey folks 1 I opened a small PR to clarify region availability + localization notes for Middle East & Africa. includes Node + Python snippets, a short migration checklist, and a curl example showing domain vs header approaches: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2678. Looking for brief legal/runtime check and an agree-to-land.

tara: looking. can we standardize on the env var pattern (REDWOOD_REGION) in all snippets? that's what our SDKs publish. also add one sentence about latency tradeoffs: "Choosing a nearby region reduces latency; choosing a region for residency may change fallback behavior."

noah: good call 1 switched snippets to env var. node example i added:
```
// node
process.env.REDWOOD_REGION = 'me-af-1'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: process.env.REDWOOD_REGION })
const r = await client.generate({ prompt: 'test' })
```

legal-ops: quick copy note 1 avoid absolutes like "data stays only in region". Suggested safe phrasing to use: "For Hosted plans, customer content is processed and stored in the selected region where available. For Dedicated and Private deployments, residency controls are available via contract (see Data Processing Addendum: https://redwood.example.com/dpa). Some operational metadata (telemetry, backups) may be processed outside the selected region; see the DPA for details." Add a short footnote about cached logs and replication settings.

eng-infra: runtime bits: regional domains are supported (api.<region>.redwood.ai). We still accept X-Redwood-Region header for compatibility, but prefer regional domain routing for new setups. KV/prefix caches are cluster-local; Dedicated/Private are region-local unless replication is enabled. Hosted will attempt regional routing and may read from another region for availability failover. Embeddings and rerank endpoints follow same routing rules. Feel free to add that line.

noah: added legal wording + footnote and the runtime sentence. included curl migration examples:
```
# recommended: region domain
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.me-af-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# legacy header fallback
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: me-af-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
Also added a tiny migration checklist: update SDK to latest minor, switch global domain -> regional domain, prefer env var region config, remove header if fully migrated.

docs-bot: Docs CI: \u2705 3/3 checks passed (links, lint, preview). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-2678

legal-ops: approved the copy with one tiny nit: please mention the Dedicated onboarding contact link for contractual residency.

noah: added Dedicated contact link and merged once CI green. thanks all! :tada:
